To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the Northeast snowfall impact scale is based on the distribution of snowfall amounts associated with Northeast snowstorms, 2) the scale has a high degree of correlation with storm impact, 3) the Northeast snowstorm impact scale can be used as a guide for snowstorm impact, 4) the Northeast snow storm impact scale is not a perfect measure of snowstorm impact, and 5) there is still more work that needs to be done.

the Northeast snowstorm impact scale is based on the distribution of snowfall amounts for the 20 most significant snowstorms in the Northeast, that the distribution is well described by a log-normal distribution, that the distribution has a standard deviation of 0.5 in log snowfall, and that the distribution can be used to assign a snowstorm to an impact category.

a scale based on Northeast storm snowfall distributions can provide useful guidance to emergency managers, the public, and the news media in assessing the potential impact of snowstorms in the Northeast and adjacent regions.

the development and application of an empirical scale for Northeast snowstorms that is based on the snowfall distribution.
the development of a snowfall impact scale that is based on the distribution of snowfall amounts from a sample of Northeast snowstorms.
the relationship of the amount of snowfall to the impact of snowfall on the Northeast.

the Northeast snowfall impact scale developed in this study is a useful and practical tool for the assessment of snowstorms and their impact in the Northeast.
the Northeast snowfall distribution is a good indicator of the potential snowfall impact.

the Northeast Snowfall Impact Scale is a useful tool for assessing the severity of snowstorms and communicating that severity to the general public.

the snowfall distribution of a Northeast snowstorm has a strong influence on the storm’s impact.
a snowfall amount alone does not provide a complete measure of the potential impact of a storm.
snowstorm impacts can be assessed by the distribution of snowfall, and this can be done in a way that is easy to understand and communicate.
